chunks: The Shaykh, may Allah support him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā, from al-Ḥasan ibn Ṣāliḥ ibn Muḥammad al-Hamdānī, from ʿAbd al-Ṣamad ibn Hārūn, who raised the hadith, saying:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “When the deceased is placed into the grave, if it is a man he is drawn in lengthwise, and the woman is taken in sideways, for that is more concealing.”

key_terms.الْقَبْرَ: the grave into which the deceased is placed
key_terms.عَرْضًا: sideways or crosswise in manner of placement
key_terms.يُسَلُّ: is drawn or slipped in gently

ai.seo_question: How should a man and a woman be placed into the grave according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a funerary ruling regarding how the deceased is placed into the grave. It distinguishes between the burial of a man and a woman, stating that the woman is to be placed in a manner that provides greater concealment.
